minutes.headline: Board of Health voted to grant two septic variances for a Baltwell Street house and a Gilchrist Street pool site.
minutes.summary: The Board of Health met remotely and heard two septic variance requests, one near wetlands and one reducing groundwater separation. Both were approved by roll call. The agent reported on COVID-19 trends and the governor's reopening schedule, and the board adjourned.

Two bedroom-count matters (Lancaster Ave and Holman Street) reported resolved and signed off by the agent, pending upload of a revised plan.

what_happened.line: The Board of Health voted to grant the requested variances for a Baltwell Street septic system, covering reduced distances to a well and to wetlands.
The board then accepted the variances and local upgrade approvals for the 30 Gilchrist Street septic system as presented; the vote passed.
The Baltwell Street applicant is to return to the Conservation Commission after the variances were approved.
The agent reported two bedroom-count matters resolved and signed off, pending upload of a revised plan, then gave COVID-19 case data and the state reopening schedule.

why_it_matters: Septic variances decide how close a system may sit to a well or wetlands on a given lot, which bears on groundwater protection and on what owners may build or repair.
watch_next: The Baltwell Street applicant's return to the Conservation Commission.
Upload of the revised plan for the Lancaster Ave and Holman Street bedroom-count matters.
